BiblicalUsage: Maqqêdâh is Makkedah, a Canaanite city Joshua took on the day of the great slaughter. In Joshua 10:10 Israel chases the enemy to Makkedah, and in Joshua 10:28 Joshua takes Makkedah and utterly destroys it and its king. In Joshua 15:41 it stands in the list of Judah's cities., and the name marks a victory and a possession.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Maqqêdâh shows me that God gives His people real victories in real places, and that the ground of those victories is worth remembering.
